question: In a certain code language, ‘FROM’ is written as ‘HSNK’ and ‘WAKE’ is written as ‘YBJC’. How will ‘JUMP’ be written in the given language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

‘FROM’ is written as ‘HSNK’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23410f6d60e91154cf78a1d366604db26ce930d4c39390fc899fb6c819e3541d.png] 

‘WAKE’ is written as ‘YBJC’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/099a1df1c3fa308da65e27650ea1eda36438eb01ee28166d25726ee038dfb145.png] 

Similarly, ‘JUMP’ be written in the given language?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21d9c855951f1d74880bc2e0495b7b75465811f90594a614fd02efb1b1953da1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
